camel_example: aliyun ecs DescribeKeyPairs --region cn-hangzhou --KeyPairFingerPrint ABC1234567 --KeyPairName 0SshKey0 --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-amnhr7u7c7hj0000' --PageNumber 1 --IncludePublicKey false --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries one or more SSH key pairs
description_zh: 调用DescribeKeyPairs查询一个或多个密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-key-pairs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name 0SshKey0 --key-pair-finger-print ABC1234567 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --include-public-key false --resource-group-id rg-amnhr7u7c7hj0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeKeyPairs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the key pairs. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair. Fuzzy search with regular expressions is supported. You can use an asterisk (*) to match subexpressions. Examples:

`*SshKey`: queries key pair names that end with SshKey, including SshKey.
`SshKey*`: queries key pair names that start with SshKey, including SshKey.
`*SshKey*`: queries key pair names that contain SshKey, including SshKey.
`SshKey`: exact match of SshKey
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。支持正则表达式模糊搜索，使用*匹配子表达式，示例：

`*SshKey`：查询以SshKey结尾的密钥对名称，包括SshKey。
`SshKey*`：查询以SshKey开头的密钥对名称，包括SshKey。
`*SshKey*`：查询名称中间有SshKey的密钥对，包括SshKey。
`SshKey`：精确匹配SshKey
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The fingerprint of the key pair. The public key fingerprint format is defined in RFC 4716 and uses the MD5 message digest algorithm. For more information, see RFC 4716 (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4716)
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对的指纹。根据RFC 4716定义的公钥指纹格式，采用MD5信息摘要算法。更多详情，请参见RFC 4716 (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4716)。
parameters.name: key_pair_finger_print

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the key pair list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include PublicKey in the response.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否在返回结果中包含PublicKey。
默认值：false
parameters.name: include_public_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the key pairs belong. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

Filtering by the default resource group is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对所在的企业资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

不支持默认资源组过滤
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count of resources that are attached with all specified tags cannot exceed 1000. If the resource count exceeds 1000, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html operation to query resources
fields.help_zh:
密钥对的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html接口进行查询
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 密钥对的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of key pairs
